facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Monitor says the right to request information from government is currently governed by the 2013 Right to Access Information Act.
The Information Minister tabled the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2026 in Parliament, which completed its First Reading on 5 November 2026 and is not yet law.
